entities.name: Code of Hammurabi
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: One of the oldest deciphered legal codes (c. 1754 BCE), inscribed on a black stele in Babylon. Its 282 laws covering commerce, family, labor, and property established the principle of written law and proportional justice.
